```{r}
library(DESeq2)

library(airway)

library(ggrepel)
```

```{r}

input_dir <- readline(
  prompt = "Enter the path to the directory containing rsem_counts.txt and sample_info.csv: "
)

counts_file <- file.path(input_dir, "rsem_counts.txt")
metadata_file <- file.path(input_dir, "sample_info.csv")

if (!file.exists(counts_file)) {
  stop("Could not find: ", counts_file)
}

if (!file.exists(metadata_file)) {
  stop("Could not find: ", metadata_file)
}

# Read RSEM counts
raw_counts <- read.table(
  counts_file,
  header = TRUE,
  row.names = 1,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Clean sample names
colnames(raw_counts) <- gsub("\\.genes\\.results", "", colnames(raw_counts))
colnames(raw_counts) <- gsub("-", ".", colnames(raw_counts))
colnames(raw_counts) <- gsub("_$", "", colnames(raw_counts))

# Round counts
counts_data <- round(raw_counts)

# Read sample metadata
colData <- read.csv(
  metadata_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  row.names = 1
)

# Check that all count-matrix samples have metadata
all(colnames(counts_data) %in% rownames(colData))

```

```{r}

keep_samples <- colData$Condition %in% c("CTR", "TIS", "REPOP")
colData_filtered <- colData[keep_samples, , drop=FALSE]

counts_data_filtered <- counts_data[, rownames(colData_filtered)]

colData_filtered$Condition <- droplevels(factor(colData_filtered$Condition))
colData_filtered$Condition <- relevel(colData_filtered$Condition, ref = "CTR")

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_data_filtered, 
                              colData = colData_filtered, 
                              design = ~ Condition)                              

keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= ncol(counts_data_filtered) * 5 
dds <- dds[keep,] 


dds <- DESeq(dds) 

resultsNames(dds) 
fl0_res <- lfcShrink(dds, coef="Condition_TIS_vs_CTR", type="apeglm") 

summary(fl0_res)
```

```{r}
draw_colnames_45 <- function(coln, gaps, ...) {
  coord <- pheatmap:::find_coordinates(length(coln), gaps)
  x     <- coord$coord - 0.5 * coord$size
  res   <- textGrob(coln, x = x,
                    y = unit(1, "npc") - unit(3, "bigpts"),
                    vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, rot = 45,
                    gp = gpar(...))
  return(res)
}
assignInNamespace(x = "draw_colnames", value = "draw_colnames_45",
                  ns = asNamespace("pheatmap"))

makeColorRampPalette <- function(colors, cutoff.fraction, num.colors.in.palette) {
  stopifnot(length(colors) == 3)
  ramp1 <- colorRampPalette(colors[1:2])(num.colors.in.palette * cutoff.fraction)
  ramp2 <- colorRampPalette(colors[2:3])(num.colors.in.palette * (1 - cutoff.fraction))
  return(c(ramp1, ramp2))
}

my_similarity_heatmap <- function(dist_matrix, anno_var, anno_label, cutoffthres, title) {
  dist_matrix          <- as.matrix(dist_matrix)
  annotation           <- data.frame(group = anno_var)
  rownames(annotation) <- rownames(dist_matrix)
  colnames(annotation)[1] <- as.character(anno_label)

  group        <- c("#bc8f8f", "#698B69", "#6495ed")
  names(group) <- levels(anno_var)
  anno_colors  <- list(group = group)
  names(anno_colors) <- anno_label

  cutoff.distance <- max(dist_matrix) / cutoffthres
  cols <- makeColorRampPalette(
    c("#b35806", "white", "#542788"),
    cutoff.distance / max(dist_matrix),
    1000
  )

  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat                      = dist_matrix,
    color                    = cols,
    border_color             = NA,
    show_colnames            = TRUE,
    show_rownames            = TRUE,
    annotation_col           = annotation,
    annotation_row           = annotation,
    annotation_colors        = anno_colors,
    cluster_rows             = TRUE,
    cluster_cols             = TRUE,
    treeheight_row           = 0,
    clustering_method        = "complete",
    clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
    clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
    drop_levels              = TRUE,
    fontsize                 = 9,
    fontsize_row             = 10,
    main                     = title
  )
}

# rlog transformation
rld <- rlog(dds, blind = TRUE)

conditions <- colData_filtered$Condition

clean_names <- ave(
  as.character(conditions),
  conditions,
  FUN = function(x) {
    prefix <- dplyr::case_when(
      x[1] == "CTR"   ~ "ctr",
      x[1] == "TIS"   ~ "tis",
      x[1] == "REPOP" ~ "repop",
      TRUE             ~ tolower(x[1])
    )
    paste0(prefix, "_", seq_along(x))
  }
)


colnames(rld) <- clean_names

condition_factor <- factor(conditions, levels = c("CTR", "TIS", "REPOP"))
names(condition_factor) <- clean_names

# 1. Euclidean heatmap 
mat_dist <- dist(t(assay(rld)))

my_similarity_heatmap(
  dist_matrix = mat_dist,
  anno_var    = condition_factor,
  anno_label  = "id",
  cutoffthres = 1.55,
  title       = "After Gene Filtering (Euclidean Distances)"
)

# 2. Pearson-correlation heatmap 
mat_cor      <- cor(assay(rld), method = "pearson")
mat_cor_dist <- as.dist(1 - mat_cor)

my_similarity_heatmap(
  dist_matrix = mat_cor_dist,
  anno_var    = condition_factor,
  anno_label  = "id",
  cutoffthres = 1.55,
  title       = "After Gene Filtering (Pearson corralation)"
)
```
